confirmations_requested.ask: Call the Central area chief: confirm whether LH-02 is really stopped at C512-06 (radio says stopped, CMMS says operating, work order closed 20 min ago). No loader moved from or to this place until confirmed.

decision_cruda.rationale: LH-01 is down at C564-14 (radio and CMMS agree). The likely repair is 13:30, so the stope would sit idle. It holds 134 t at 12.1 g/t, about 52 oz. LH-09 is an LH410 on the Central preparation heading, which is worth only 1.5 oz/h. It loads 29.1 t/h there, about 11 oz/h, and travel is 0.34 h. The 134 t takes about 4.6 h, so it clears before 17:00. The cost is about 7 oz of development, so net is about 42-45 oz. Central stockpile is 174/450 t, so there is room. I did not touch LH-02 because of the radio/CMMS conflict (CONFIRM-01). LH-10 is in PM until 12:00 and I did not use it. The Norte and Este loaders are producing, so I left them alone.
